verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Signifyd's fraud/guarantee API (Sale, Checkout, chargebacks, webhooks, device profiling) but contains no mention of SCA, 3DS, PSD2 exemptions, or any European payment-authentication routing logic. Nothing indicates the product decides when to trigger 3DS versus request an exemption. missing for 10: any documentation of SCA/3DS handling, exemption request logic, or PSD2-specific routing features.
